text_block_list.text: (RUUUUMBLE!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Kiseki. Today, she starts from this 
position.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(They're really watching me. They're 
expecting me to make a move...!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Even as summer ends, your spirits remain 
high. Come on, Kiseki, you're looking 
great!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (Just like this! I can do it—!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Haaah!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki takes 1st place! Taking the 
glorious victory is Kiseki!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*... *haa*... I'm going to seize 
it...! The autumn summit, the Climax... 
I'll take it all...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Ghh, Trainer...! Yes, that's another 
step forward!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And just like this—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "I will win the Autumn Tenno Sho!!"
—A few days after the Kyoto Daishoten.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu♪ I sa~w it, Kiseki-san! Your new 
manga.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Taking 1st place in the Kyoto Daishoten 
too—as expected!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Wah, thank you!? I literally just uploaded 
it!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...That was crazy intense, wasn't it? I'm 
pretty proud of how I recreated that run 
from the Kyoto Daishoten in my manga!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm not giving up the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki-san's manga is really fun, you 
know? Super fun.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Reality is that I'm gonna win, though! No 
matter how much you've evolved.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...—Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, I see! So you're my opponent 
again!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I'm strong, after all♪

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yeah, absolutely! Your late-kick burst is—
(—Thump...!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—...Because you girls have such incredible 
sharpness...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: You "guys"~?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huh... ...Wait!?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Geez, you've got your eye on another rival 
besides me? When I'm right here?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well, if you're running in a Gâ , you have 
to pay attention to everyoneâ...wait, 
that's not what I meant!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Of course, Vivlos-chan is a formidable 
opponent! I'll come up with a proper 
strategy just for her!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'll think about it, but—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on the Track
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaahhhhh—! Haaaaaaahhhhh—!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *sigh*... Man, you're runnin' 
crazy fast, ain'tcha...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Lara stays right on my tail, though! Never 
once, running alongside her, have I felt 
certain of victory!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I won't let my guard down for the Shuka 
Sho either. Let's make it a sensational 
race!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Hah... ...Well, let's get goin'.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (—Ai-chan is a "fast" Umamusume, too.)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(Such sharp acceleration. No matter the 
gap ahead, she has the power to turn it 
all around...)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...gh—, I'm letting my mind wander far too 
much...! Ever since summer ended, 
constantly...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
......I have plenty of other rivals 
besides you. So why am I so...――

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Nngh, I wonder if manga protagonists 
felt this way too?! My head is throbbing 
so hard...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: If you really are my destined rival—!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...I will win...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'm not the one who's gonna lose...!

"And on the day before the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn) press conference for the 
contenders, Kiseki came to me with a 
proposal."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Let's create a brand-new special move!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos-chan is our opponent at the Tenno 
Sho (Autumn)! So let's adapt my running 
style to match my rival!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...For instance, running in a way that 
completely shuts down anyone, no matter 
what kind of late kick they have."

"'Late-race burst.' In today's 
speed-focused races, its importance cannot 
be overstated."

"That is precisely why an Umamusume's 
strength is judged by the speed of her 
final three-furlong split time."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm going to take on those 
late-surging runners head-on and beat 
them!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"No matter how fast the opponent is, no 
matter if they specialize in sudden bursts 
of speed, I'll completely neutralize their 
strengths."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —I will create an absolute sensation.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'm going Front Runner!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No matter what kind of late-race burst 
they have, I won't let them turn this into 
a home stretch duel!

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, Kiseki declared she's running as a 
front-runner...!?" "And in public like 
this, no less...!?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
W-W-Wait a second! Kiseki-san!? Are you 
sure about this!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
"You have an amazing final burst of speed 
too! Besides, blurting out your strategy 
in public like this—"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Isn't that cool?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure they'll prepare countermeasures. 
Every single strong Umamusume here at this 
press conference."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“I'm gonna beat every single one of them! 
I won't let anyone step on my shadow!!”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Will my stamina hold out? How fast can I 
go, and how far can I pull away from my 
rivals?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Now then! I'm starting to feel the 
romance in this!"

With little time left until the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn), I hastily reorganize the 
training menu, switching to a regimen 
tailored for a Front Runner style.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry for such a sudden change.
choice_data_list: That's my job. I really don't mind at all!
It's my job, so I don't mind at all!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you so much! Well then, please 
help me with the finishing touches!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“No matter what, running that grips the 
turf is off the table this time!”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Reaching top speed while preserving 
stamina. That is our absolute top priority 
this time.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I have to reconstruct my running right now 
for optimal performance...!
choice_data_list: You do it because you can, right?
You're doing it because you can, right?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, of course! ...Because I'm the 
protagonist!!

Soon begins Kiseki's primary challenge 
—the Senior Autumn Triple Crown.
